## J-02 + H-01  Approvals stop being an invisible bottleneck

Every 2 hours it sweeps **13 approval registers** at once - commission approval, expense claims, purchase requests, payment approvals, vendor invoices, bank-change requests, leave, vendor due diligence, marketing and advertising budgets, lead transfers and salary advances.

- past `remind_after_hours` (24) it emails the named approver
- past `escalate_after_hours` (72) it goes over their head to the Director, on email + WhatsApp + Slack
- anything worth more than `director_threshold_aed` goes to the Director from the first reminder, whoever is named on the record

All four numbers live in the **Config** node.

WITH pending AS (
  SELECT 'TXN-004' AS form_code, 'Commission Approval' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("transaction_ref", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULL::text AS approver_name,
         COALESCE("net_commission", 0)::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_txn_004
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending', 'Finance Verified')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'FIN-001' AS form_code, 'Expense Claim' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("employee_name", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         COALESCE("amount", 0)::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_fin_001
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'FIN-002' AS form_code, 'Purchase Request' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("item_description", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         COALESCE("estimated_cost", 0)::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_fin_002
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'FIN-004' AS form_code, 'Payment Approval' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("payee_name", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         COALESCE("amount", 0)::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_fin_004
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending', 'Verified')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'FIN-006' AS form_code, 'Vendor Invoice Verification' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("vendor_name", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("verified_by", '') AS approver_name,
         COALESCE("invoice_amount", 0)::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_fin_006
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'FIN-007' AS form_code, 'Vendor Bank Change' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("vendor_name", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         0::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_fin_007
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Requested', 'Verified')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HR-007' AS form_code, 'Leave Request' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("employee_name", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         0::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_hr_007
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'VEN-002' AS form_code, 'Vendor Due Diligence' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("vendor_name", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         0::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_ven_002
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-003' AS form_code, 'Campaign Budget Approval' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("campaign_name", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         COALESCE("requested_amount_aed", 0)::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_mkt_003
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Submitted')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-005' AS form_code, 'Marketing Content Approval' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("content_title", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         0::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_mkt_005
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Submitted')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-008' AS form_code, 'Advertisement Budget Approval' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         doc_no AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         COALESCE("requested_amount_aed", 0)::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_mkt_008
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Submitted')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'AGT-005' AS form_code, 'Lead Transfer' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("lead_id", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         0::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_agt_005
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Requested')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PAY-003' AS form_code, 'Salary Advance / Loan Request' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("employee_name", ''), doc_no) AS subject_txt,
         NULLIF("approved_by", '') AS approver_name,
         COALESCE("amount", 0)::numeric AS amount, created_at
  FROM frm_pay_003
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
)
SELECT form_code, form_title, id, doc_no, status, subject_txt,
       approver_name, amount, created_at,
       ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc')
             - to_timestamp(substr(created_at, 1, 19),
                            'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))) / 3600.0, 1)
       AS hours_pending
FROM pending
ORDER BY hours_pending DESC;
